items.title: Use frozen closeout for DONE milestone_status
items.context: When a story is DONE and milestone-closeout.json exists, milestone_status must render a stable Milestone Status table from the frozen closeout/source snapshot instead of recomputing live evidence against archived active files.

happy.desc: A DONE story with milestone-closeout.json renders Milestone Status with completed rows and does not show stale evidence or blocked rows after active cleanup.

edge.desc: Active non-DONE stories continue to use live milestone_status freshness checks, and DONE stories without closeout still fail closed rather than fabricating success.

adversarial.desc: The JSON and text outputs preserve read-only boundaries and do not mutate evidence, ledger, checklist, summary, phase, or closeout files.

items.userSees: User runs lattice milestone_status --storyId=<DONE-story> and sees Milestone Status with completed closeout rows, no stale evidence warnings, and empty Current/Remaining sections when the closeout snapshot is complete.

verificationEvidence.note: Real DONE story B-e62e now renders snapshot-backed Milestone Status with M1 and M2 under Completed, both shown as ✅ Done, no Current/Remaining rows, and no stale evidence or blocked warnings.
Focused regression verifies active non-DONE stories still use live projection and DONE stories without closeout remain fail-closed instead of fabricating completed rows.
Regression and build verify JSON/text snapshot-backed milestone_status remains read-only and MilestoneStatusReport-shaped while preserving existing argument boundary tests.

items.title: Document DONE snapshot status contract
items.context: Update CLI documentation to say active stories use live projection while DONE milestone_status reads the closeout snapshot when present, keeping the developer-facing three-section table stable after cleanup.

happy.desc: Docs mention the DONE closeout-backed Milestone Status behavior and the clear status icon contract.

edge.desc: Docs keep JSON/no-ledger behavior explicit so machine output and missing ledgers are not silently changed.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not claim milestone_completion_set or completion ledger support in this story.

items.userSees: User reads docs/CLI.md and sees: "For DONE stories with milestone-closeout.json, milestone_status renders the frozen Milestone Status table from that closeout snapshot; active stories continue to use live projection."
